data.name: AAAI 2014 Accepted Papers
data.abstract: This data set compromises the metadata for the 2014 AAAI conference's accepted papers, including paper titles, authors, abstracts, and keywords of varying granularity.

additional_info.summary: CSV format where each row is a paper and each column an attribute.
additional_info.variable_info:
Title: Free text; title of the paper
Authors: Free text; author(s) of the paper
Groups: Categorical; author-selected, high-level keyword(s)
Keywords: Free text; author-generated keywords
Topics: Free text; author-selected, low-level keywords
Abstracts: Free text; paper abstracts
